title: First Store Page Live - Repost
author: Tookitooki12
selftext:
**This is a repost / replacement post** because I had the wrong trailer in both the Steam store and original reddit post. I want to own up to my mistake, but also don't want the wrong version floating around. *"The full two minutes of black screen at the end of your trailer are a great indicator of how much care and attention you put into your product."* Is something I will take to heart before hitting upload or save on anything else though. It stung and felt a bit unfair (subjectively), but objectively was a totally fair sentiment also direct and constructive. Thank you internet stranger. 

Original post summarizes to "omg I'm not from this background but I published something AI is great" which for me is still true, but also wanted some feedback / tips from people that actually do this for a living. 

Premise is a chess game where the AI feels less like AI (selective blindness, depth visibility, limited thinking time) and where players can learn to get better at chess through chess puzzles and matches against varying AI difficulties. There is also a ledger where chess concepts are organized as player encounters them, and a hero/chess army customization system. Art is a mix of asset packs, and Gen-AI (sketches, first draft, too many iterations on nitpicking details ). - I may in the next year leading up to full release try to commission this or do the art myself. 

Demo build is approved and so is the main store page, but the demo store page is still pending approval so demo will be released hopefully this week. 

Plan right now is release the demo, gather feedback, and continue to tweak / update the main build until release sometime in the next year as I have limited time between main job and family/baby. Any feedback would be greatly appreciated!

Any feedback, tips on marketing/PR/release would also be much much appreciated from the veterans! (example: should I have waited on this post until I was able to release the demo??)

TIA!

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271310/Kingside\_Break/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271310/Kingside_Break/)
